# dokploy_network (Resource)

Manages a Docker network in Dokploy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Local bridge network with custom IPAM
resource "dokploy_network" "bridge_network" {
  name        = "apps-bridge"
  driver      = "bridge"
  internal    = false
  attachable  = true
  enable_ipv4 = true
  enable_ipv6 = false
  mtu         = 1450

  ipam {
    driver = "default"

    config {
      subnet   = "172.30.0.0/16"
      gateway  = "172.30.0.1"
      ip_range = "172.30.10.0/24"
    }
  }
}

# Overlay network in a remote Dokploy server
resource "dokploy_network" "overlay_network" {
  name        = "apps-overlay"
  driver      = "overlay"
  internal    = false
  attachable  = true
  enable_ipv4 = true
  enable_ipv6 = false
  server_id   = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Docker network.

### Optional

- `attachable` (Boolean) Whether standalone containers can attach to this network.
- `driver` (String) Docker network driver.
- `enable_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether IPv4 is enabled.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 is enabled.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the network is internal.
- `ipam` (Attributes) IPAM settings for the network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipam))
- `mtu` (Number) Optional MTU for the network.
- `server_id` (String) Optional target Dokploy server ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the network.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID that owns this network.

<a id="nestedatt--ipam"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipam`

Optional:

- `config` (Attributes List) IPAM config entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipam--config))
- `driver` (String) IPAM driver.

<a id="nestedatt--ipam--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipam.config`

Optional:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP for the subnet.
- `ip_range` (String) IP range within the subnet.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet CIDR for the network.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import dokploy_network.bridge_network "network-id-123"
```
